# Egg tracking fixtures

Three small grayscale crops retained with the owner's standing permission:
clear shell, shell crossed by straw, and bedding after removal. They share a
coordinate system at the detector's measurement scale. No timestamps, camera
overlay, hen identities, or deployment configuration are included.

These are regression inputs, not recognition references or a training dataset.
Only strict ellipse detections may acquire eggs; straw fragments may retain an
already confirmed track but must not create one.
